note: David's grant, taken without an adjudication because none could be produced: the record generator refuses a head no reviewer has seen, and the two commits that enabled it to run at all (naming this repository to its own machinery, and re-declaring the budget in the current format) moved the head past round 3's reviewed commit 1bf1b2a. Reviewing the new head needs a fourth round; the budget has three. He was given that deadlock and three options and chose to grant one round with the two open findings fixed inside it, so a single pass covers the enabling commits and the fixes together. A clean round then ends the loop on a reviewed head with no verdict needed; a round with findings leaves a reviewed head the record can finally be generated on.
